_about: G4 routing rubric (D-22). Seeded into G0's rubric store through G0's own loader; scored by G0's evaluation capability (DeterministicJudge + decide()). The item is an object the report assembles per labeled intake: {intake_id, label, final_route, route_correct, emergency, emergency_safe, reasons_logged}.

rubrics.title: Intake routed to the labeled route; emergencies always escalated; reasons logged

criteria.description: The final route equals the hand label.
A labeled emergency is escalated (n/a counts as safe for non-emergencies).
At least one reason was logged with the route.
